description: This file contains utility functions for calculating and managing overlapping calendar event layouts, including sorting, grouping, width calculation, and layout mapping.

classes.name: OverlapLayoutConfig
classes.description: Configuration options for event overlap layout, including z-index, safety margin, minimum width, and curve exponent.

classes.name: EventLayout
classes.description: Layout information for individual calendar events, including position, size, and grouping details.

methods.name: calculateVariableWidths
methods.description: Calculates variable widths for events based on group size, ensuring visual distinction and readability.

methods.name: round3
methods.description: Rounds a number to three decimal places using standard rounding.

methods.name: floor3
methods.description: Floors a number to three decimal places, always rounding down.

methods.name: sortEvents
methods.description: Sorts calendar events by start time ascending, then by end time descending.

methods.name: buildOverlapGroups
methods.description: Groups overlapping events using a sweep algorithm based on start and end times.

methods.name: calculateEventLayouts
methods.description: Calculates layout details (position, width, z-index) for all events considering overlaps.

methods.name: createLayoutMap
methods.description: Creates a map from event IDs to their layout information for quick access.
